content.value: The 10 kg block is attached to link AB and rests on a conveyor belt which is moving to the left. Knowing that the coefficients of friction between the block and the belt are $\mu _ { s } = 0 . 3$ and $\mu _ { k } = 0 . 2 5$ and neglecting the weight of the link, determine (i) the force in link AB, (ii) the horizontal force P which should be applied to the belt to maintain its motion.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Special Examination (COVID-19), 2020
